rationale: OLMoE3 recipe used CosWithWarmup where WSD was intended; both produce monotonic lr curves so runtime trace cannot distinguish them. Must be caught at build-time by asserting scheduler_class matches recipe intent. Borderline lr_schedule vs control_flow: chose lr_schedule because root cause is scheduler selection. pi_precond=true (precond is recipe==OLMoE3-WSD).
